record.original_question: Consider "non- C0 -semigroups", e.g., bi-continuous semigroups, and describe appropriate regularization properties.

evidence.quote: Problem (Regulariziation property of non-C0 -semigroups). Consider ”non- C0 -semigroups”, e.g., bi-continuous semigroups, and describe appropriate regularization properties.

artifact.status_search_result: A search reveals that regularization properties (immediate differentiability, analyticity, Gevrey classes, immediate norm continuity) are well developed for $C_0$-semigroups, and there is ongoing literature on bi-continuous semigroups (e.g., generation theorems, approximation, perturbation, flows on networks). However, no comprehensive theory of regularization properties specifically tailored to bi-continuous (non-$C_0$) semigroups appears to be established; the question is posed as an open program rather than a settled result.

status_evidence.title: Bi-continuous semigroups for flows on infinite networks
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses bi-continuous semigroups as a framework for non-$C_0$ situations but does not develop a general regularization/smoothing theory.
status_evidence.claim: Bi-continuous semigroup theory is active but does not currently include a developed regularization theory analogous to the $C_0$ case.

status_evidence.title: Relation between Semigroup Growth and Resolvent Decay for Immediately Differentiable Semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Treats regularization properties such as immediate differentiability for $C_0$-semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Regularization properties are classically studied for $C_0$-semigroups; the extension to bi-continuous semigroups remains a research direction.
